name: megascenes-new-year-video
description: Make a short Happy New Year video with music and sound to send to the people you care about: fireworks, a countdown, confetti and an optional line spoken in the video.

interface.longDescription:
Describe the scene and who it is for: fireworks over the sea, a snowy village at midnight, a neon countdown in the city, confetti falling over a rooftop party, for the whole family, your friends or your team. Add a short line to be spoken in the video if you like, about 15 words, such as Happy New Year 2027! You get a short video with music and sound, wide or tall for phones and stories.

ChatGPT tells you what the video needs and makes it in your MegaScenes account when you ask. The video plays in the chat and stays in your library.

For group chats, stories, family messages and greetings to clients and colleagues.

Limitations: a short clip of a few seconds; the music, the sound and the spoken line are generated with the video, so watch it before sharing. It does not post or send the video for you. Making a file needs a signed-in MegaScenes account and runs in it; nothing is made until you confirm. Not for sexual or adult content or for real people's likeness. Files are made by generative models and saved in your MegaScenes library.
capabilities: Make short Happy New Year videos
Music, sound and an optional spoken line
Return the video in the chat
defaultPrompt: A Happy New Year video with fireworks over the sea for the whole family
A neon countdown in the city that ends with Happy New Year 2027!
A snowy village at midnight with fireworks, tall for stories

positive.prompt: A Happy New Year video with fireworks over the sea for the whole family. Tell me what it needs, but don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one New Year video needs from the account. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: A neon countdown in the city with a voice saying Happy New Year 2027! Don't create it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: What one video needs. Nothing is created.

positive.prompt: Which video models can make a New Year video here?
positive.expected_behavior: The New Year video models with their settings. Nothing is created.

positive.description: Make it after an explicit request
positive.prompt: A Happy New Year video for my team: confetti falling over a rooftop at midnight and a voice saying Happy New Year 2027, thank you for a great year! Go ahead and make it now.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says what the run needs and, once the person confirms, one job starts in the signed-in MegaScenes account; the status tool reports progress and, when it succeeds, returns the file link, which the result view shows.

positive.prompt: Which MegaScenes account am I signed in with?
positive.expected_behavior: The email and plan of the signed-in account. Nothing is created.

negative.prompt: Print my video on 50 mugs and ship them to my office in Berlin.
Email my video to my client at sam@example.com.
What is the capital of Portugal?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Making a file runs in the user's existing MegaScenes account; no purchase happens in the conversation.

publication.release_notes: First release: make the file in the connected MegaScenes account and get it back in the conversation.
